requests.name: common
requests.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready transparent game sprite atlas for My Squishy Lab. Input image is a STYLE reference only: keep its premium 3D glossy jelly/resin look, cream and lilac raised sculpted symbols, mint accents, warm peach highlights. Create ONE square 4 by 4 atlas of sixteen separate sculpted 3D UI SYMBOLS, centered precisely in sixteen equal cells with generous transparent padding, no overlaps. NO button backplates, NO flat vector graphics, NO outlines, NO words, NO labels, NO borders, NO grid lines, NO background. Each symbol is a tactile rounded molded toy with glossy specular highlights, thick dimensional edges, lilac purple resin and pearl cream highlights, front-facing camera, soft upper-left lighting consistent throughout. Row1 left to right: small dollhouse workshop house, back chevron, forward chevron, two pause bars. Row2: question mark, curved reset arrow, mixing bowl with wooden stirring paddle, pouring jug tipping a short thick gel ribbon. Row3: fingertip pressing a glossy jelly dome, soft rounded cube squeezed inward with two small inward arrows, stretchy jelly with two outward arrows, toy camera. Row4: little collection shelf with three squishies, gift box with bow, artist colour palette, save floppy-disk symbol. High-quality whimsical children's toy workshop artwork matching the attached reference. Every icon whole and uncropped. Alpha transparency around every object.

requests.name: utility
requests.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single transparent production sprite atlas for a glossy children's squishy workshop game. Match the reference's dimensional mint-green, pearl cream and lilac-purple resin, thick rounded molded surfaces, beautiful white reflections and warm soft lighting. Create ONE atlas with exactly 16 independent 3D toy symbols laid out in FOUR ROWS of FOUR icons. Strict equal-size cells. Each object must fit in the CENTRAL 70% of its own cell with large clear transparent gutters on all four sides; no object reaches any cell boundary. Orthographic front view, same scale and soft upper-left lighting. Row1 left-to-right: little smiling face disc, plain unmarked blank face disc, framed photograph, landscape-picture background tile. Row2: music note, sound speaker with sound waves, little microphone, mint leaf quiet-mode symbol. Row3: gold coin with a raised star, purple padlock, pearly gear settings, wooden paintbrush with mint paint. Row4: three glittering iridescent stars together, three jelly beads, little charm jar holding a star, lilac silicone dumpling mould. These are fully sculpted glossy raster 3D artwork, NOT vector or flat icons, NO heavy outlines. No text, no labels, no grid lines, no backplates behind the individual symbols, no background. Transparent alpha. Keep every object complete, separate, centered and uncropped. Do not include extra objects or symbols.

requests.name: surfaces
requests.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single transparent game UI sprite atlas, six blank glossy molded squishy button surfaces for My Squishy Lab. Use the reference solely for material, lighting and finish. Exactly TWO COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, precisely separated by generous clear alpha gutters. In each cell one completely blank front-facing rounded-square cushion button with thick softly bulging molded edges, realistic glossy jelly-resin highlights, cream pearly rim, warm peach reflection at the bottom and polished translucent depth. Each button entirely inside central 70% of its equal cell. Row1: pearl-cream resting raised button on left, matching pearl-cream pressed/compressed lower button on right. Row2: bright mint green resting raised button on left, matching mint green pressed/compressed lower button on right. Row3: soft lilac-purple resting raised button on left, matching lilac-purple pressed/compressed lower button on right. Paired states must keep same width, camera and lighting, only subtle thickness/compression differences. Orthographic front view. NO symbols, NO icons, NO text, NO letters, NO logos, NO decorative objects, NO border/grid lines, NO cast shadow extending beyond a cell, NO background. All six are premium dimensional children's toy UI artwork, NOT flat vector graphics. Transparent alpha.

requests.name: actions

Strict FOUR ROWS and FOUR COLUMNS, sixteen equal cells, transparent gutters, every symbol centered inside central 70% of its cell. Row1 left to right: chunky mint checkmark, chunky lilac X close, chunky lilac plus sign, chunky lilac minus sign. Row2: lilac arrow curving left for undo, lilac curved arrow turning left around a little mint cube, lilac curved arrow turning right around a little mint cube, glossy eye look/view symbol. Row3: cream upward arrow above a tiny mint squishy, cream downward arrow below a tiny mint squishy, little mint cube straight front view, three jelly droplets of increasing size. Row4: mint four-direction move arrows, two glossy lilac crossing remix arrows, pearly parent-safety shield with mint checkmark, small lilac rubbish bin with pearl cream lid. NOT flat graphics, no ink outlines, no text or labels, no extra shapes, no backplates, no scenery, no grid lines. All sixteen icons entirely visible and fully separate. Alpha transparent background.
